sources.snippet: LOCALHOST NYC 2026 · Track 2.2, Own the Model How do you address your husband's sister's husband in a Hindi birthday card? We trained a 4-bit Qwen3-0.6B on an Apple Silicon laptop to generate relationship-specific terms in Devanagari. The first adapter covered ten relationships.
